title: Sign value of the OR function
statement: For any natural number $s$ and any vector $v\in\{-1,1\}^s$, let the OR function take value $1$ when every coordinate of $v$ is $1$, and value $-1$ otherwise. Identifying each sign with its real value, its output is $2\prod_{i=1}^s\frac{1+v_i}{2}-1$.
